# LeadPilot AI CRM — Release Notes v1.0.0 (Enterprise GA)

**Release Date:** July 26, 2026  
**Milestone:** LeadPilot AI CRM Enterprise General Availability  

---

## Key Highlights

- **AI Workspace (`src/domain/ai/workspace/`)**: Unified AI copilot interface aggregating context across Leads, Contacts, Deals, Tasks, Appointments, Communications, Documents, and Analytics.
- **Workflow Automation Engine (`src/platform/workflows/`)**: Event-driven automation engine executing user assignments, tasks, notifications, emails, WhatsApp messages, and record updates.
- **RAG Knowledge Base (`src/domain/knowledge/`)**: Decoupled embedding and vector store architecture supporting document and CRM note semantic search.
- **Multi-Tenant SaaS Foundation (`src/platform/tenant/`)**: Enforced organizational boundary isolation (`organization_id`).
- **Observability Suite (`src/platform/observability/`)**: Realtime health check, metrics collector, monitoring, and audit dashboard services.
- **Security & Production Hardening**: Completed `SECURITY_AUDIT.md` and enterprise operations runbooks.
